question.en: Distinguish between Narrow Money and Broad Money. Why is M3 considered a better indicator of the total money supply in the economy?
question.hi: Distinguish between Narrow Money and Broad Money. Why is M3 considered a better indicator of the total money supply in the economy?

modelAnswer.en: Narrow money (M1) focuses on immediate liquidity. Broad money (M3) includes time deposits, capturing the store-of-value function of money, making it a comprehensive indicator for monetary policy.
modelAnswer.hi: Narrow money (M1) focuses on immediate liquidity. Broad money (M3) includes time deposits, capturing the store-of-value function of money, making it a comprehensive indicator for monetary policy.
